title: Server Operations Workflow
summary: Trace a server through a controlled operations workflow.
objectives: Explain receive, inspect, inventory, configure, test, monitor, and document steps.
Distinguish simulated configuration from physical equipment handling.

vocab.def: Moving a prepared system into an approved operating role.
The stages an asset passes through from receipt to retirement.

sections.heading: Order reduces risk
sections.body: A controlled workflow makes ownership, configuration, testing, and monitoring visible. It also creates a record another person can follow.

sections.heading: Physical boundaries
sections.body: Heavy rack installation and energized equipment handling require qualified supervision. This lesson uses a paper or browser model.

practice.prompt: Which step should come before declaring a simulated server ready?
practice.answer: Test the intended configuration and document the result.

quiz.question: Why is inventory part of deployment?
options: It connects the system to an accountable record
It proves a system is reliable forever
quiz.answer: It connects the system to an accountable record

lab.objective: Sequence a synthetic server deployment workflow and identify safe handoffs.

reflectionPrompt: Which deployment record would help someone investigate a later problem?
